changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 2 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/7397-remove-duplicate-chart-primitives.md`

- names `packages/components/shadcn-components.json` → `packages/components/shadcn-components.json` — edited by this change

  > `packages/components/shadcn-components.json` records `chart` under `customComponents` with `movedToPlugin: "@object-ui/plugin-charts"`, which is what keeps `pnpm shadcn:update-all` from re-fetching the primitive and silently undoing this.

### `.changeset/9569-components-stylesheet-source-none.md`

- names `shadcn-components.json` → `packages/components/shadcn-components.json` — edited by this change

  > `@object-ui/components`' Tailwind entry opened with a bare `@import 'tailwindcss'` — the only one of this repository's four stylesheet entries without a `source(none)` pin. Tailwind v4's automatic source detection was therefore ON, and it roots at the PROCESS working directory, so it scanned every non-ignored file in the package: `CHANGELOG.md`, `README.md`, the markdown beside the renderers, `shadcn-components.json`, even an English sentence in a comment inside `tsconfig.test.json`. Every class-shaped token in that prose compiled into a real rule in the published `dist/index.css`.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `41ae65b26` (merge-base with origin/main): 10 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1564 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (2151 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36291473094)

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `fc7bcdd5dc884b0f6e5e457058f7c71756846d71`

### ① Derived judgments

Read: card objectui#10722 (body + 3 comments), triage `5851675691`, claim `5851804361`, PR #10745 body/files/check-runs, the diff `c3a26ccda..fc7bcdd5d` (11 files, +884/−3) via `refs/review/pr-10745`, AGENTS.md (#7, #11, 版本号策略, 测试纪律, changeset rule at :168), `.changeset/config.json`, `scripts/shadcn-local-patches.mjs` header and families. The os-dev-report was not used as evidence; every claim below is re-derived from the diff or from CI.

**Behaviour, accepted-set and published-surface changes, item by item (file:line at the head):**

1. `packages/components/src/lib/date-fns-locale.ts` (new, 278 lines). `dateLocaleKeyFor` :199-219 resolves the `useDisplayLocale()` tag to a date-fns locale code (tag as given, then `language-region`, then `language-script` from `Intl.Locale#maximize`, then bare language, then `en-US`); `loadDateLocale` :231-250 (memoised, in-flight shared, rejected load not memoised); `useDisplayDateLocale` :256-278. RIGHT against triage 5851675691's option (a), 「resolve a date-fns `Locale` from the display tag in one shared place」: it is the one shared place — all three consuming files import it (`custom/date-picker.tsx:16`, `renderers/form/date-picker.tsx:15`, `ui/calendar.tsx:20`) and no other file under `packages/**` or `apps/**` resolves a date-fns locale. Not reached from `src/index.ts` (untouched; its `lib/` exports at :39-42 are still `utils` and `lazy-icon`).
2. `custom/date-picker.tsx:38,52`: `format(date, "PPP", { locale })`. RIGHT: card site 1; the pattern is unchanged.
3. `renderers/form/date-picker.tsx:23,60`: `format(value, schema.format || 'PPP', { locale })`. RIGHT: card site 2; `schema.format` is still the date-fns pattern and still the argument. The registration's input at :81 still reads 「date-fns format string」 and `defaultProps.format: 'PPP'` at :87 is unchanged. Triage constraint 1 (「`DatePickerSchema.format` keeps its declared meaning, a date-fns pattern, and is still honoured」) holds; `packages/types/src/form.ts` is untouched (`format?: string`, `@default 'PPP'`).
4. `ui/calendar.tsx:20,36,40`: `locale={displayDateLocale}` is the first attribute of the DayPicker element and `{...props}` at :180 is its last. RIGHT: card site 3; caller precedence preserved.
5. `packages/components/shadcn-components.json:80`: `localEdits` prose extended (judged sentence by sentence in ②).
6. `scripts/shadcn-local-patches.mjs:373-424,436` (family `calendar`, two patches), `scripts/__tests__/shadcn-local-patches.test.ts:193-204,294-302` (fixture entry, family-id pin), `scripts/__tests__/fixtures/shadcn-registry/calendar.registry.txt` (213 lines): outside the claim's named surface; judged under No-Touch below.
7. `.changeset/10722-date-fns-display-locale.md`: `'@object-ui/components': patch` (judged in ②).

No accept set moves (types untouched; the `date-picker` and `ui:calendar` registrations' `inputs`/`defaultProps` unchanged). No published export moves (`src/index.ts`, `src/ui/index.ts`, `packages/components/package.json` untouched — `exports` still `.` and `./style.css`; the new module is not re-exported). Claim limits: no `package.json` change (diff stat on `packages/components/package.json`, root `package.json`, `pnpm-lock.yaml` is empty); no eager locale bundle (below); `DatePickerSchema.format`'s meaning unchanged; no new published prop (`locale` is DayPicker's own existing prop, nothing new is declared).

**Missing asks:** none found. Triage's execution note, item by item: measure-first — the PR reports base 6 failed / 4 passed; the six failing rows are exactly those whose expected strings cannot come from date-fns `enUS`, which is what base passes (no `locale` at either `format` call, none on the DayPicker element), and the four passing rows are the `en-US`, unknown-tag and caller-locale controls. Census — re-derived from `refs/review/pr-10745`: 2 date-fns `format` sites, 1 DayPicker mount (`ui/calendar.tsx:39`), 5 Calendar-element mounts (`custom/date-picker.tsx:56`, `renderers/form/date-picker.tsx:64`, `renderers/form/calendar.tsx:55`, `packages/plugin-calendar/src/CalendarView.tsx:347`, `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DashboardFilterBar.tsx:167`); this matches the PR's 8-row table, whose row 8 (`formatMonthDropdown`, machine locale) is declared in `packages/i18n/src/__tests__/machineLocaleCensus-9909.test.ts:252-267` and is reached only under a dropdown `captionLayout` no first-party caller sets. Each face gets the one shared resolution (rows 5-7 through the Calendar element). Pins: the measured face (form picker label) and one caption, with `enUS` under `en-US` as the control. `Fixes #10722` is the body's first line. The (a)/(b) decision is written in the body with reasons (why (b) cannot hold constraint 1 for `PPP` under `en-US` nor for textual authored patterns, and the four axes).

**Done that was not asked:** the four No-Touch-route files (compliant, below). The private module exports four helpers for its pin (`DATE_LOCALE_KEYS`, `dateLocaleKeyFor`, `loadedDateLocale`, `loadDateLocale`) — module-internal, not published. The Calendar element calls the hook even when a caller passes `locale` (`ui/calendar.tsx:36`), so a display-locale chunk may be fetched and unused in that case: an inefficiency, not a defect. `"use client"` on the new module matches its sibling payload files (`lib/close-label.tsx`, `lib/sidebar-cookie.ts`).

**Existing pins edited or deleted:** one test file touched, `scripts/__tests__/shadcn-local-patches.test.ts`, +23/−0: a `REGISTRY_FIXTURES.calendar` entry and one added `it`. Nothing deleted, no assertion loosened. The generic `it.each(patchedComponents())` suites (fixture present, sha256 matches, every anchor applies to registry bytes with `already` empty, byte round-trip or pinned reason, shipped file carries its markers) pick up the new family automatically. No guard weakened.

**Can the new pins fail:**
- `packages/components/src/__tests__/date-picker-display-locale-10722.test.tsx` (10 rows). Lit control: the `en-US` rows at :97-102 and :160-164 pass on base and after. Positive legs fail on base: `4. März 2020`, `Mittwoch, 4. März 2020`, `März 2020`, `Mo Di Mi Do Fr Sa So` cannot be produced by `enUS`. Negative legs: `sw-KE` and `not a tag` must still read `March 4th, 2020` after a macrotask (:129-138) — catches a chain that over-matches or throws; `locale: it` under `de-CH` must read `marzo 2020` before and after a macrotask (:166-172) — catches the default overriding a caller. The first-paint leg (:118-127) asserts `enUS` synchronously and then French: deterministic, because `vitest.config.mts` leaves `isolate` at its default (fresh module graph per file, so the module's `loaded` map starts with only `en-US`) and pins `TZ=UTC` at :56; the module-scope static imports of `date-fns/locale/de`, `fr-CH`, `it` at :41-43 use the same specifiers as the module's dynamic imports, as AGENTS.md 测试纪律 asks.
- `packages/components/src/__tests__/date-fns-locale-10722.test.ts`. Loads all 95 keys and asserts `locale.code === key` (:30-40): a mistyped specifier rejects the import, a mistyped export name makes `.code` throw. Negative leg at :75-82: no UI language other than `en` may fall through to `en-US` — checked by hand against `packages/i18n/src/locales/registry.ts:78-86` (en→en-US, zh→zh-CN via maximize, ja, ko, de, fr, es, pt, ru, ar each have a loader line). The chain rows (:51-69) include the maximize cases `en`→`en-US`, `zh`→`zh-CN`, `zh-Hant`→`zh-TW`, `sr-Latn-RS`→`sr-Latn`, and case-folding `EN-gb`→`en-GB`. Ran green in CI (`Test (shard 1/8)` … `(8/8)` success).

**The No-Touch zone (AGENTS.md #7, :103).** The rule says never edit `src/ui/**` logic and names a `custom/` wrapper. The repo's actual practice is `scripts/shadcn-local-patches.mjs`: its header declares that edits which must survive regeneration are data the sync re-applies, that the payload stays out of `src/ui/` as 「a one-line reference to code that lives somewhere the sync never touches (here: `src/lib/`)」, and that `find` is written from REGISTRY bytes; four families already exist (`sheet`, `dialog`, `sidebar`, `slider`), and the dialog close-label family is this exact class — an i18n hook injected into a primitive with the payload in `src/lib/close-label.tsx`. The PR follows that shape. Wrapper alternative: `Calendar` is published through `src/ui/index.ts:17` (`export * from './calendar'`) and consumed by plugin-calendar and plugin-dashboard from `@object-ui/components`; a `custom/` wrapper could only reach 「every Calendar」 by re-pointing that barrel (the module behind the published `Calendar` name moves) and would leave the inner `ui/calendar.tsx` primitive on `enUS` for any direct importer. Judged: the declared-patch route is the repo's precedent for this class and the better one; complies with #7 as practised.
- Anchors from REGISTRY bytes, re-derived offline: the fixture's sha256 recomputed is `745a6c30a70681c3ae88cb1421317ec5d06d02202e615f12db700e1776311148`, equal to the recorded value at test :200. On the raw fixture the import anchor has 0 hits (it reads `@/lib/utils`) and the body anchor 1; after `rewriteRegistryImports` (`scripts/shadcn-sync.js:361`, `@/lib/` → `../lib/`) the engine at the head gives applied 2, already 0, failed 0, and a second application gives already 2 — idempotent. The import anchor is the same line the dialog family anchors on. It would survive a `pnpm shadcn:update` at these bytes; drift beyond them is the weekly `shadcn:check` job's reading, as the test header says.
- Payload: one import line, one `const displayDateLocale = useDisplayDateLocale()`, one attribute; no logic in `src/ui/`. Yes.
- The fixture is what it says: same shape as the four siblings (`"use client"`, `@/lib/utils`, `@/registry/new-york/ui/button`); it carries upstream's Tailwind v3 `[--cell-size]` spelling and a `month_grid` class line the shipped file lacks — bytes that cannot have come from the local file — and no marker. Diffing shipped `ui/calendar.tsx` against registry-plus-patch leaves exactly the ObjectUI header, the `(--cell-size)` spellings and the missing `month_grid` line, which is the `roundTrip` reason recorded at :203. The `headSha` provenance (`8a7701ec2`) is not re-derived here (network is outside this review's read bounds); the sha256 pin is the offline hold.
